factions.name: Frontier Cooperative
factions.membership_rule: Trade fairly, avoid civilian violence, and establish a secure workshop.

factions.name: Riverside Works
factions.membership_rule: Demonstrate industrial capacity, restore machinery, and avoid theft from guarded factories.

factions.name: Civil Defense
factions.membership_rule: Protect cities and honorable factories, defeat raiders, and maintain good standing with Riverside Works and Survey Detachment 7.

factions.name: Territorial Militia
factions.membership_rule: Predatory conduct and damage to civilized industry earn access; membership conflicts with civilized factions.

factions.name: Survey Detachment 7
factions.membership_rule: Produce research archives and respect restricted scientific sites.

factions.name: Ashline Raiders
factions.membership_rule: Only an openly predatory playstyle can earn an invitation; joining excludes settlement factions.
